stimulus_text: The cameraman begrudgingly brought the awkward equipment up from the basement to the director.
The salesperson displayed the watch for customers.
On the weekend the helpful film director brought the inexperienced cameraman to his equipment in the storeroom.
The foreign company purchased a decrepit apartment block from the wealthy family for an outrageous price.
As a marketing technique the shopkeeper prominently placed the watch on a dedicated stand for customers.
The cleaner spoke to the secretary about the patient.
Shortly before the election the company unwittingly purchased a defective apartment block from the family.
The director sold the cameraman's equipment.
The customer watched over the display for the shopkeeper.
The family blocked the purchase of their vintage car by the company.
The nonprofit organisation wrote to the politician about the reporter.
The shopkeeper displayed the watch for his customers.
The lobbyist wrote to the newspaper about the reporter.
Each day the shopkeeper displayed the watch to customers in his store.
What did the shopkeeper display?
The psychologist warned the secretary about the patient.
The secretary recommended the patient to the psychologist.
The renowned director brought the impatient cameraman to the equipment from his last project.
The dog noticed the strange object near the children.
Who saw the strange object?
The stubborn family blocked the purchase of the apartment by the company for six months.
The cute little dog smelled a strange object near the young children in the grass.
The company purchased a valuable painting from the family.
A customer watched over the display for the shopkeeper.
The academic wrote to the lobbyist about the politician.
The government purchased the apartment block from the family.
The dog smelled the strange object near the children.
The customer critiqued the display for the shopkeeper.
With its heightened sensory perception the dog smelled an unusual object near the large group of children at the school.
Where did the dog smell an unusual object?
The family secured the purchase of their apartment by the company.
The exhausted secretary spoke slowly to the patient about their psychologist late in the evening.
The customer patiently watched over the well-organized display for the shopkeeper for hours on end.
After five long days the disappointed children finally objected to the unpleasant smell of their favourite new dog.
Using pen and paper the reporter meticulously wrote a personal letter to the lobbyist about the politician.
Whom did the reporter write to?
The dog sniffed the strange object near the children.
One per week the psychologist spoke delicately to her experienced secretary about her most difficult patients.
The director brought the cameraman to his equipment.
The director inexplicably brought the cameraman to the useless old equipment in the storeroom.
The lobbyist wrote to the politician about the reporter.
The group of children objected to the unpleasant smell of the large black dog from the park.
Where was the dog from?
Every day the customer watched over the display for the shopkeeper during lunch.
The lobbyist wrote to the politician about the journalist.
The children objected to the unpleasant smell of the cat.
A team of cameramen brought all the necessary equipment to the busy director.
A small company purchased the drab concrete apartment block from the family for later redevelopment.
Every morning the cameraman brought the equipment to the impatient director.
The uncaring children objected to the smell of the sick dog at the vet.
The shopkeeper displayed the watch for customers.
The cameraman brought the equipment to the director.
The shopkeeper displayed books for customers.
The secretary often spoke to the patient about the psychologist.
The shopkeeper marketed the watch to customers.
Occasionally the psychologist accidently spoke to his secretary about one patient within earshot of other patients.
For no good reason the family blocked the purchase of an old apartment by the local company for six months.
A psychologist spoke to her gardener about the patient.
Every morning the director brought the cameraman to the expensive equipment.
